summary.text: Joey Andrews is a Democratic state representative from Michigan House District 38 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an attorney and policy analyst.

paragraphs.text: Joey Andrews was born in St. Joseph, Michigan, and earned a bachelor's degree from Carson-Newman University in 2013 and a law degree from Wayne State University in 2016.
His career experience includes working as a policy analyst.
Andrews assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

In 2023-2024 he served as majority vice chair of the Criminal Justice and the Communications and Technology committees; in the 2025-2026 session he sits on the Communications and Technology, Energy and Transportation committees.
